We spend our lives searching for a Philosopher’s Stone, believing something miraculous can fix our broken pieces. But the ultimate alchemy isn't bending the world to our will—it’s trading our pride to embrace our fragile, human hearts, standing empty-handed, and realizing we were complete all along.
